scenes.headline: How three compression steps shrink a field ViT
scenes.sub: H-BAC pruning, attention distillation and INT8, chained on a chilli-leaf classifier.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Stoat! A farmer's phone can't carry a full-size vision transformer. Here's how this paper squeezes a leaf-disease classifier down to six megabytes.

scenes.text: A cheap curvature estimate decides how much of each block to prune, and a first-order score decides what goes. Then distill, then quantize.
scenes.say: The new piece is the pruner. A cheap curvature estimate decides how much of each block to cut, and a simpler score decides exactly what goes.

items.say: First, H-BAC prunes the ViT to half its active parameters.
Then a small TinyViT student learns from the teacher's attention.
Last, its weights are stored as eight-bit integers. Six megabytes.

steps.say: For each of the twelve blocks, H-BAC estimates curvature with ten random probe vectors, instead of building the full Hessian.
Curvature sets each block's pruning ratio. Surprisingly, sharper blocks get pruned more, not less, and that direction wins.
Inside each block, a first-order score picks which attention heads and neurons to remove.
Then one epoch of recovery fine-tuning absorbs almost all of the damage.

left.title: Feature distillation
items: Needs a learned adapter to bridge them
left.say: Matching raw features fails on shape: the teacher is seven hundred and sixty-eight wide, the student one hundred and ninety-two.

right.title: Attention distillation
items: Same shape in both, so no adapter
right.say: Attention maps have the same shape in both, so the student copies which patches relate to which, with no adapter.

scenes.title: Accuracy at the same 6.01 MB
scenes.say: The honest check: a TinyViT trained directly and quantized reaches the same size at ninety-four point eight seven percent. Chaining didn't clearly beat it.

scenes.text: Curvature can budget pruning and attention maps can teach a student, but check any chain against simply training the small model.

recap: H-BAC: curvature sets each block's budget
Attention maps teach a student, no adapter
scenes.say: To recap: curvature budgets the pruning, attention maps teach the student, and INT8 finishes the job.
